scripts.build: npm run check && npm run build:client && npm run build:data
scripts.build:client: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && esbuild src/map.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --outdir=dist/public/assets --loader:.png=file --log-level=warning
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev
